title: Torsors with a specified section and their isomorphism classes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $G$ be an abelian sheaf and use the $G$-torsors of [def-sc-gm-torsor]. For an object $U$, a torsor with section is a pair $(P,s)$ with $s\in P(U)$. Two such pairs are isomorphic if a $G$-equivariant sheaf isomorphism takes one specified section to the other. This is an equivalence relation; its quotient is the type of isomorphism classes of torsors with section over $U$.
